# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# Stage 1: build
FROM rust:1.88-slim AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pkg-config libssl-dev ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ADD https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/releases/download/v0.8.2/sccache-v0.8.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz /tmp/sccache.tar.gz
RUN tar -xzf /tmp/sccache.tar.gz -C /tmp && mv /tmp/sccache-v0.8.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/sccache /usr/local/bin/sccache && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sccache
ENV RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache SCCACHE_DIR=/sccache CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0
WORKDIR /app
COPY {{rustPrefix}}Cargo.toml ./
COPY {{rustPrefix}}src ./src
{{sourceCopy}}
{{MIGRATE_COPY_START}}
{{MIGRATE_COPY_END}}
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/usr/local/cargo/registry,sharing=locked --mount=type=cache,target=/sccache,sharing=locked cargo build --release

# Stage 2: runtime — extends the builder (keeps cargo + sources + the build cache) so the verify pipeline's in-container `cargo test` runs; mirrors the TS Dockerfile, which ships node + sources + devDependencies for the same reason. A debian-slim runtime strips cargo and fails `docker compose run rust cargo test`.
FROM builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates libssl3 curl sqlite3 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/{{binaryName}} /usr/local/bin/{{binaryName}}
{{MIGRATE_RUNTIME_COPY_START}}
{{MIGRATE_RUNTIME_COPY_END}}
COPY deterministic /app/deterministic
COPY {{rustPrefix}}scripts/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
ENV PORT=4000
ENV DETERMINISTIC_DIR=/app/deterministic
EXPOSE 4000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=5s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=12 \
  CMD curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:4000/api/health || (echo "probe failed" && exit 1)
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["{{binaryName}}"]
